Game Overview

Mini Switcher is a retro title where master gravity manipulation as you guide a plucky blob through 30 dynamic levels. Mini Switcher's vibrant, tactical gameplay tests your timing against colorful foes and intricate obstacles, all while enjoying a nostalgic pixel art style and enchanting retro soundtrack.
